original.question: Jab Sophie apne bhatija ki dekhbhal karti hai, toh wo uske liye alag-alag khilone nikalti hai. Building blocks ke bag me 31 blocks hote hain. Stuffed animals ke dabbe me 8 stuffed animals hote hain. Stacking rings ke tower me 9 rang-birange rings hote hain. Sophie ne haal hi me bouncy balls ka tube khareeda, jisse uske bhatija ke liye khilonon ki kul sankhya 62 ho gayi. Tube me kitne bouncy balls aaye?
original.answer:
Maan lijiye T tube me bouncy balls ki sankhya hai.
Balls ke tube khareedne ke baad, Sophie ke paas 31 + 8 + 9 + T = 48 + T = 62 khilone hain uske bhatija ke liye.
Isliye, T = 62 - 48 = <<62-48=14>>14 bouncy balls tube me aaye.
